exposure: proportion of time in Category II fetal heart rate tracing (FHRT) prior to birth
cohort: The study included 2,780 nonanomalous term (>= 37 weeks) singleton deliveries in labor.
finding: The proportion of time in Category II FHRT in the 20-120 minutes prior to birth among term singletons was not significantly associated with composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery for nonreassuring FHRT did not significantly differ across groups based on the proportion of time in Category II FHRT.
